name: 12587-throughput-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 256 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt exactly 4000 tokens and output exactly 1000, both fixed at min = max, temperature 0.0. The vllm_python backend renders the prompt through the chat template, so the engine sees roughly a dozen tokens more than the declared 4000.
purpose: A long-document summarizer on one 80GB GPU, serving an 8-billion-parameter model to 32 concurrent users with 4000-token prompts and 1000-token replies.
launch:
# vLLM 0.7.0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not
# add keys taken from a later vLLM.

# LOCAL PATH: no hub repo carries this checkpoint in the native block-FP8 layout this engine loads
# block-scaled weights from. Build recipe in setupcard.md.
model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-BLOCK-native

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false

# SCHEDULER MODE, pinned rather than inferred. Left unset, max-model-len resolves to the
# checkpoint's 131072; arg_utils.py:1096 then reads `max_model_len > 32768` and silently turns
# chunked prefill ON, and config.py:1489 caps max-num-batched-tokens at 2048. That splits a
# 4000-token prompt across steps and mixes it with decodes, so mixed steps carry ~2048 tokens and
# the pure 32-sequence decode steps the declared workload is built on never occur. 8192 is above
# the ~5040 wire tokens of the longest request (4000 prompt + chat template + 1000 output) and
# below the 32768 trigger, so max-num-batched-tokens resolves to 8192 and prefills stay whole.
max-model-len: 8192
enable-chunked-prefill: false
